annotations.title: Find contract vehicles for an industry

description:
For 6-digit NAICS codes (and an optional agency): the shared contract vehicles (GWACs,
    multiple-award IDIQs, GSA Schedule, BPAs) carrying last complete year's contract money in those
    codes, the share through each and who each is reserved for (read from its name).

agency.description: An agency to limit to, by name or code, e.g. "Department of Veterans Affairs" or "036".
agency.title: Agency

naics.description: One or more 6-digit NAICS codes, e.g. ["541511", "541512"].
naics.title: Naics

name: vehicle_match
